title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Fifty thousand Pesos for the Aid of the Unemployed and Other Persons Seeking Relief.

text.en:
The sum of fifty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury,
not otherwise appropriated, to relieve and succor persons who are in distress due to unemployment, and other
persons found deserving of material aid.

This amount shall be expended by the Director of Public Welfare or any relief agency under the
supervision of the Bureau of Public Welfare, subject to such rules and regulations as the Secretary of Public
Instruction may approve.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 1, 1934.
